meta.title: Planner with assign permission can assign using the same filtered list

args.phrase: Planner role-based permissions with PR assign allowed

steps.note: Ensure the planner has the permission required by the scenario.
Open the Purchase Requisitions area required for the assignment flow.
Stay on the Open PR tab.
Select the specified PR item so assignment becomes available.

args.goal: Open the Assign control next to Upload PRs, inspect the complete Search a user list by scrolling to the end, verify that only users allowed for this planner are listed, select an allowed user, and complete the assignment; stop when the screen shows the assignment succeeded

steps.note: Perform and observe the user filtering and assignment interaction that has no dedicated catalog step.
Confirm the assignment produced a success response.
